name: netdesign-session-guard
description: Netdesign Session Guard: free WordPress plugin (wordpress.org)

scripts.i18n: docker exec -u 1000 -w /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/netdesign-session-guard php-backend wp i18n make-pot . languages/netdesign-session-guard.pot --domain=netdesign-session-guard --exclude=scripts,docs,dist,node_modules && node scripts/i18n.mjs && docker exec -u 1000 -w /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/netdesign-session-guard php-backend sh -c 'wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-php languages'

author: Tomer Ofer <tomer@netdesign.media>
